case_name: Virsa Singh v. State of Punjab

pages.text:
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
Virsa Singh ... Appellant
versus
State of Punjab ... Respondent
Coram: Vivian Bose, P.B. Gajendragadkar, JJ.
Judgment Dated: 11 March 1958

BOSE, J.:
1. The appellant Virsa Singh was convicted under Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code for the murder of Khem Singh. The appellant thrust a spear into the abdomen of the deceased with great force, cutting through the intestines and causing death.

3. Decision: Once these elements are established, the offence is murder under Section 300 Thirdly punishable under Section 302. It is not necessary to prove that the offender intended to cause death; it is sufficient if he intended to inflict the bodily injury which was objectively sufficient in the ordinary course of nature to cause death. Appeal dismissed.
